$comment: This file is illustrative. It is NOT the shipped registry and nothing
Schema: see src/core/config.ts (validateRegistryFile). A loadable registry
is { providers: [...] } and each provider follows the ProviderConfig shape:
id, kind, baseUrl, apiKeyEnv, maxPrivacy, models[].
Keys are NEVER stored here — only the environment-variable NAME (apiKeyEnv).
For the real, validated local registry see registry/ollama.json.

models.note: EXAMPLE/UNVERIFIED: capability, context and price are placeholders, not facts.
